purpose: check that complete user journeys work across the real system, with a small stable set of high-value tests
entry_criteria: The system is deployed to a test environment with realistic integrations
Test accounts and data are available
procedure: Choose a small set of journeys that cover the highest business value; leave detail to lower-level tests.
Write each test from the user's point of view with stable selectors and explicit waits on conditions, not fixed sleeps.
Create the data each test needs and clean it up, so tests run independently and in any order.
Run in CI against a fresh deployment and capture screenshots, traces and logs for failures.
Treat a flaky test as a defect: fix, quarantine with owner and expiry, or delete.
Report which journeys passed and which are not covered.
acceptance_criteria: Each critical journey has a test
Tests are independent and use waits on conditions
Flaky tests are tracked with owners
worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Five journeys (sign up, search, add to basket, pay with the sandbox gateway, view order history) run in a fresh environment in eleven minutes, each creating and removing its own data.
